summary: A Go command-line tool with subcommands, configurable settings, actionable errors and human or JSON output.
description: Write a Go utility with Cobra subcommands and Viper settings layered from defaults, files, environment and flags. Results have human and JSON forms, while structured failures explain the next action. The first command exercises those boundaries, and the Makefile covers building, tests and checks. Add your utility's behavior; select goreleaser separately for tag-driven distribution.
seoDescription: A Go CLI recipe with Cobra subcommands, layered Viper configuration, actionable errors and human or JSON output.

projectExamples.title: Configuration inspector
projectExamples.description: Add commands that explain effective settings and show where overrides came from. Reuse the configuration precedence and JSON output contract.

projectExamples.title: Release artifact checker
projectExamples.description: Implement local archive and checksum checks, then add goreleaser to distribute the utility through tagged GitHub releases.

plain.whatItIs: A starter for a terminal program written in the Go language, with settings and clear error messages.
goodAt: Commands that read settings from files, environment variables and flags
Output for people to read, or in a structured form scripts can parse
Error messages that say what went wrong and how to fix it
notGoodAt: Graphical apps with windows and buttons; choose a web or desktop stack.

requests: build a terminal utility whose commands also work in scripts
let users override saved settings with environment variables and flags
make command failures explain how to fix the problem
give my Go tool consistent help and version output
run a Go binary on machines without Node installed
